Package org.saidone.protoalf.platform

Class GrpcContentService

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.ContentServiceImplBase
org.saidone.protoalf.platform.GrpcContentService
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.grpc.BindableService, AutoCloseable, org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.AsyncService
public final class GrpcContentService extends org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.ContentServiceImplBase implements AutoCloseable
Exposes document content access and streaming transfers through gRPC.

getReader(org.saidone.protoalf.api.GetContentRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.GetContentResponse>) returns a byte slice or extracted UTF-8 text, and getWriter(org.saidone.protoalf.api.UpdateContentRequest, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.Node>) replaces document content. Unlike local Alfresco readers and writers, these RPCs exchange bytes rather than live Java handles. The streaming extensions download stored bytes and upload new documents larger than a unary message can hold.

Downloads resolve the reader in a read-only transaction, then stream outside that transaction to avoid duplicate output on transaction retries. Uploads spool bytes to a temporary file and create the document in a retryable read-write transaction only after the client completes. Repository work always runs as the authenticated caller. Downloads respect transport readiness and use a dedicated bounded executor. The owner must call close() when disposing a directly constructed adapter.

  • Method Details

    • getReader

      public void getReader(org.saidone.protoalf.api.GetContentRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.GetContentResponse> observer)
      Returns a bounded slice of stored bytes or extracted UTF-8 text. Offsets are byte offsets in the selected representation. A zero limit selects 2 MiB; explicit limits must be 1..2 MiB. Text slices avoid ending inside a UTF-8 character. Text offsets inside a character and limits too small for the first character yield INVALID_ARGUMENT; callers must use a character boundary and a sufficient byte limit.

      A missing transform facility or unsupported input format yields FAILED_PRECONDITION; transform content failures yield UNAVAILABLE. This RPC materializes bytes rather than returning an Alfresco reader handle.

      Specified by:
      getReader in interface org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.AsyncService
      Parameters:
      request - document reference, text-extraction flag, byte offset and slice limit
      observer - receives one content slice with total size and continuation flag, or a gRPC error

    • getWriter

      public void getWriter(org.saidone.protoalf.api.UpdateContentRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.Node> observer)
      Replaces the stored bytes of an existing document and returns its updated metadata. Content must be supplied; empty bytes are allowed. A blank MIME type is guessed from the node name and a blank encoding defaults to UTF-8.

      This remote adaptation performs the write immediately rather than returning an Alfresco writer handle. The request must fit the configured inbound message size.

      Specified by:
      getWriter in interface org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.AsyncService
      Parameters:
      request - document reference and required content bytes with optional MIME type and encoding
      observer - receives one updated document snapshot, or a gRPC error

    • downloadContent

      public void downloadContent(org.saidone.protoalf.api.DownloadContentRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.DownloadContentResponse> observer)
      Streams stored document bytes without text extraction. The response starts with content metadata, followed by data messages of at most 1 MiB. A document without stored content emits only metadata.

      The reader is resolved transactionally as the caller; bytes are emitted afterwards so transaction retries cannot duplicate output. I/O failures yield INTERNAL; client cancellation stops the transfer. Excess concurrent transfers yield RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; paused transfers retain their slot.

      Specified by:
      downloadContent in interface org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.AsyncService
      Parameters:
      request - document or frozen-version node reference to download
      observer - receives metadata followed by ordered byte chunks, then completion, or a gRPC error

    • uploadContent

      public io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.UploadContentRequest> uploadContent(io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.Node> observer)
      Creates a new document from a client stream consisting of one header followed by data chunks.

      Bytes are spooled before repository creation; no node is created until the client completes. The maximum total payload is MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES. Protocol violations and excess size yield INVALID_ARGUMENT; missing caller identity yields UNAUTHENTICATED.

      Specified by:
      uploadContent in interface org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentServiceGrpc.AsyncService
      Parameters:
      observer - receives one created document after commit, or a gRPC error
      Returns:
      a request observer that consumes the header and content chunks
